purpose: Neutral, consent-gated description of observable interview-video signals; not candidate merit scoring.

quality_gates.note: Initial engineering defaults for suppressing unreliable observations only; not empirically validated thresholds and not candidate score thresholds.

measurements.name: screen_region_gaze_ratio
measurements.definition: Valid gaze samples in a broad calibrated screen region divided by valid gaze samples.
measurements.permitted_insight: Estimated gaze direction was within the calibrated screen region for X% of valid samples.

measurements.name: gaze_direction_event_rate
measurements.definition: Sustained gaze-direction changes per valid tracked minute.
measurements.permitted_insight: X sustained gaze-direction changes were detected.

measurements.name: head_pose_event_rate
measurements.definition: Pose changes above a calibrated threshold per valid tracked minute.
measurements.permitted_insight: X head-pose changes were detected in the measured interval.

measurements.name: face_visibility_coverage
measurements.definition: Frames with usable face detection divided by eligible frames.
measurements.permitted_insight: Face tracking was available for X% of eligible frames.

measurements.name: valid_visual_tracking_coverage
measurements.definition: Time with valid visual tracking divided by eligible interview time.
measurements.permitted_insight: Visual tracking was available for X% of the response.

measurements.name: repeated_motion_event_count
measurements.definition: Count of repeated movement events from a validated detector.
measurements.permitted_insight: X repeated movement events were detected; interpretation is not available.
